Introducing Saved Views, available today for every customer. Whether you organize work by status, priority, assignee, or due date, you can now capture the exact filters and sort order you rely on and return to them in a single click—no need to rebuild your setup each time you open a project.

Saved Views is included in all paid plans at no extra cost. Each user can create and store up to 50 personal views, so whether you're tracking sprint progress, monitoring overdue tasks, or watching a specific client's workload, your favorite setups are always ready when you need them.

Saved Views also work great for teams: any view can be shared with teammates, giving everyone the same filtered perspective without asking them to recreate it themselves. This makes standups, reviews, and handoffs faster, since the whole team can look at the same slice of work at the same time.

We built this feature based on your feedback, and we hope it makes your daily workflow noticeably smoother. Open any list and select Save view to get started.
